original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Deploy Java Application as Systemd Service
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    app_name: myapp
    app_user: myapp
    app_group: myapp
    app_home: /opt/{{ app_name }}
    app_jar: "{{ app_name }}.jar"
    java_version: "21"
    service_file: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ app_name }}.service"
  tasks:
    - name: Install OpenJDK {{ java_version }}
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "openjdk-{{ java_version }}-jdk"
        state: present
      notify: Reload systemd

    - name: Create application group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ app_group }}"
        state: present
        system: yes

    - name: Create application user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        home: "{{ app_home }}"
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        system: yes
        create_home: no

    - name: Create application directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ app_home }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Copy application JAR
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ app_jar }}"
        dest: "{{ app_home }}/{{ app_jar }}"
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: '0644'
      notify:
        - Restart application service

    - name: Create systemd service file
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: app.service.j2
        dest: "{{ service_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      notify:
        - Reload systemd
        - Restart application service

    - name: Enable and start application service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        enabled: yes
        state: started
        daemon_reload: no

  handlers:
    - name: Reload systemd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: yes

    - name: Restart application service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        state: restarted
      listen: "Restart application service"
